sentence: Splits a fixed bill evenly across everyone in the chat, shows who has paid and who still owes, and lets members mark themselves paid or the collector confirm payments.
use_when: Splitting a shared cost like league fees or team gear evenly among the group
Tracking who has paid one person who is collecting the money
Checking how much is still owed before a due date
Collecting dues from a team, club or class
dont_use_when: Splitting by different amounts per person or by who ate what
Tracking running expenses or debts between friends over time
Actually sending money or taking card payments
Voting or polling on a decision
